messages:
maya (IR): sec-ops-bot just flagged an SSO anomaly for mark@redwood.com — impossible travel. two successful logins ~30m apart (US-WEST -> NL). noticed multiple MFA push attempts (6 pushes over 10m), most rejected.
sec-ops-bot: [ALERT] SSO anomaly detected
 - user=mark@redwood.com
 - anomaly=impossible_travel
 - score=0.87
 - events=2026-03-20T03:10Z login-success ip=18.204.12.45 us-west; 2026-03-20T03:40Z login-success ip=88.99.45.21 nl
lee: okta admin console confirms failed password attempts earlier this morning. no new app authorizations in OAuth logs.
jordan (SRE): containment actions applied: revoked all active sessions for mark, forced password reset, revoked refresh tokens, and added a temporary deny rule for 88.99.0.0/16.
sam (IAM): checking service-account/key exposure and KMS activity for mark's principal now.
maya (IR): also confirm any recent RBAC changes for mark — need a quick audit of group/role changes.
lee: RBAC dump: mark -> groups: [platform-apps], role=developer, no admin roles. no role/grant changes in last 90 days.
sam (IAM): KMS audit: no Decrypt or Encrypt API calls by mark's principal in last 24h. last KMS usage by mark was 7 days ago against the staging key (read-only).
maya (IR): containment looks solid. next steps: org-wide hunt for MFA-push fatigue patterns and more impossible_travel alerts.
jordan (SRE): created saved search in Splunk: `index=auth okta_event=*impossible_travel* OR mfa_push_attempts>3 | stats count by user, src_country` — running now.
lee: running the query, will tag users with >3 push attempts in 1h window and surface high scores.
sec-ops-bot: ticket INC-2026-0319 created, priority=P2, assignees=maya,sam,lee.
maya (IR): comms plan: notify the affected user (mark), security leadership, and SOC partner. avoid external/public comms at this point. I'll draft the user notification.
sam (IAM): recommendation: enable Smart Lockout in Okta, apply per-user MFA push rate-limiting, and consider raising impossible_travel threshold for auto-actions. If we later find key misuse, rotate affected keys.
jordan (SRE): post-incident action proposal: implement automated playbook to revoke sessions when impossible_travel score > 0.8 AND push_attempts >= 4.
lee: quick OAuth check: no tokens minted to third-party apps for mark in the 24h window.
maya (IR): good. please record all actions to audit logs (session revoke entry, password reset, IP block rule id). we'll need those for postmortem.
lee: recorded: session_revoke@2026-03-20T03:52Z, password_reset@2026-03-20T04:01Z, ip_block_rule=tmp-block-88nl-0319.
maya (IR): user contacted at 03:58Z, confirmed they did not initiate the NL login. user is locked until they confirm and complete password reset.
sec-ops-bot: status=contained
maya (IR): follow-ups: 1) run org-wide split/aggregate search for push-exhaustion signals 2) update SSO runbook with auto-revoke rule 3) add an alert to audit KMS Decrypt calls tied to impossible_travel alerts 4) schedule 1:1 with IAM to discuss rate limits. I'll make a doc and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
jordan (SRE): noted, will work on the playbook template.
sam (IAM): will evaluate impact of Smart Lockout on SSO UX and write rollback steps.
lee: will attach Splunk query/results to the incident ticket.
maya (IR): thanks team — containment confirmed, moving to investigation/follow-up. keep this thread for updates only.
